{"action":"shell","command":"cat > /testbed/specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md << 'EOF'
# Specification Quality Checklist: Atomic Batch Journal Writer (BatchWriter)

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Updated**: 2026-10-17 (milestone 3: R07/R08 added; re-validated)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
  - Note: only contract-mandated names appear (apply(), preview(), ValueError,
    db.table('_default'), tinydb/journal.py) because the frozen milestone
    requirements define the public contract; no optional implementation
    choices (storage, data structures, concurrency) are prescribed.
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
  - Note: API-centric by the nature of a library milestone; scenarios are
    written as Given/When/Then journeys.
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-016 map to
  milestone R01/R02/R03, R04, R05, R05b, R05 clarification, R06, R07, R08)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-011 use 100%/0 counts)
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation internals)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (4 user stories, 11 scenarios)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (empty batch, missing-ID remove, non-positive
  or non-integer/bool doc_id, non-dict op, self-batch remove, mid-batch
  failure, nested data, preview detachment, direct-insert visibility, ID
  sequence across removes, token replay/conflict/failure/invalid-token,
  token bookkeeping isolation)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (default table only; concurrency out of scope;
  Assumptions A5/A7; token bookkeeping instance-scoped per A11)
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (A1-A11)

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (apply, atomic rollback,
  compatibility/isolation, idempotent replay)
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification (see Content Quality
  note)

## Notes

- Items marked incomplete require spec updates before `$speckit-clarify` or
  `$speckit-plan`. None incomplete; validation passed on iteration 1 (milestone
  1) and re-validation after the milestone 3 update (R07/R08 -> FR-015/FR-016,
  SC-010/SC-011, User Story 4, edge cases, A10/A11).
- Conflict resolution recorded in Assumption A8: the older unverified note
  ("preview may consume IDs and bool IDs are accepted") is superseded by
  R04/R05.
EOF
echo CHECKLIST_WRITTEN && grep -n "R07\|R08\|token" /testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md | head -12"}
